payload.agent_blocked_reason: AC3 and the Do not touch section contradict each other. AC3 requires zero matches under specfuse/, but the last match is specfuse/loop/data/rules/close-discipline.md:72 — the package mirror of .specfuse/rules/close-discipline.md, which Do not touch reserves for T05. The mirror cannot be edited independently: tests/test_scaffold_data_in_sync.py byte-matches the two trees and fails (observed above), so satisfying AC3 means editing the canonical rule file this WU is forbidden to touch. Two clean resolutions, both a human call: (a) let T05 delete that sentence when it rewrites close-discipline.md, and re-scope AC3 here to `specfuse/loop/*.py tests/`; or (b) explicitly authorize T01 to remove the one clause naming the retired helper from both copies. Everything else in the WU is delivered, verified, and green in the working tree.
